key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.7s): Initial archival pose of rain; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=1.82s): Mid-sequence articulation of rain; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.06s): Peak dynamic extension of rain over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.3s): Follow-through and settle of rain with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of rain (0.7s..4.3s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
